subject: 50-agent swarm expansion of beam4pm's ggen-manufactured slice, plus adversarial fixes
claim_ceiling: 39-agent content-generation phase (23 new bpm:RecordType instances, 12 doc/ops files, 4 new pack templates producing 6 additional generated artifacts) plus a 10-agent adversarial verification phase that found and led to 4 real template/ontology bug fixes and 5 documentation-accuracy corrections. This remains a bounded slice -- type/struct manufacturing only, no algorithms, no Gleam/Ash, no playground.

phase_1_content_generation.real_issue_caught_before_integration: one agent (template:json-schema) returned a narrative description of its work instead of the actual template file content, despite claiming in that narrative to have run real verification (ggen sync run, jsonschema validation) -- caught by inspecting the actual returned content before integrating, and the real template was authored directly instead of trusting the claim

real_bugs_found_and_fixed: k8s_object_ref.namespace wrongly required (cluster-scoped Kubernetes kinds have no namespace) -- fixed to optional
beam4pm_types.erl.tmpl declared record types without -export_type, producing real dialyzer 'Unknown types' errors for external callers -- added -export_type
beam4pm_types.schema.json.tmpl emitted no 'GENERATED... Do not edit' marker unlike every other template -- added via draft-07 $comment
both EUnit test templates redundantly -export'd their own auto-exported _test/0 functions, a real warning that becomes a hard failure under warnings_as_errors -- removed the redundant -export blocks
the pack's own ontology.ttl declared bpm:fieldRequired's range as xsd:boolean while every template compares it as a plain string -- fixed the range to xsd:string
documentation_corrections: .github/pull_request_template.md was copy-pasted unmodified from ggen-ecosystem (wrong repo name, referenced nonexistent just doctor/certify-test/chicago targets and AGENTS.md) -- rewritten for beam4pm
examples/README.md falsely claimed examples/erlang and examples/elixir subdirectories did not exist -- rewritten to describe the real, verified-runnable demos

beam4pm-process-model-pack/README.md documented only 4 of 11 templates and incorrectly described to: paths as relative to the template's own location -- corrected to list all 11 and state the real project-root-relative resolution

.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/new-record-type.md's worked example used values (xsd:string, bpm:PascalCase names) that violate the pack's own closed field-type enum and naming convention -- rewritten to match the real, implemented convention

sojourn_time's doc no longer uses 'waiting' language that actually describes the separately-modeled sync_time concept
oc_declare_constraint's enum doc corrected non_co_occurrence -> non_coexistence (standard DECLARE constraint template naming)
event_type/object_type.attribute_names' doc gained the 'Optional' prefix used by every other optional field, plus a note that per-attribute value types are not yet modeled
known_limitations_disclosed_not_fixed: all 31 constructors silently accept and drop unknown/extra map keys
neither language's constructor performs runtime value-type checking (presence-only validation)
event_type and object_type (and, more narrowly, dfg_edge vs heuristic_arc) are structurally identical with no discriminant

ocel_attribute and object_attribute_change remain two overlapping, non-unified shapes for a similar concept
